actions.name: Sweet-talk
actions.blurb: Chat up whoever is guarding the way in. Staff stay charmed for a few beats.

lines.crit: {crew} charms the whole front desk and leaves with a free tote bag.
lines.success: {crew} sweet-talks the clerk into a long story about her cat.
lines.partial: {crew} gets past, but says 'my cat' at exactly the wrong moment.
lines.fail: {crew} is asked to show a ticket. There is no ticket.

actions.name: Distract
actions.blurb: Start a commotion so everyone looks the wrong way. Loud, so it can wake things.

lines.crit: {crew} starts a spontaneous conga line. Every head turns.
lines.success: {crew} points at the ceiling and shouts. Everyone looks up.
lines.partial: {crew} causes a scene, but half the room keeps staring at the door.
lines.fail: {crew} shouts 'fire' into a room full of people who are already leaving for lunch.

actions.name: Disguise
actions.blurb: Borrow a uniform and a confident walk. Lasts a few beats.

lines.start: {crew} pulls a uniform out of a laundry bag.
lines.crit: {crew} is mistaken for the manager and handed a clipboard.
lines.success: {crew} slips into a staff jacket two sizes too large and nobody blinks.
lines.partial: {crew} is in uniform, but the name badge says 'TRAINEE (LIFEGUARD)'.
lines.fail: {crew} puts the jacket on inside out.

actions.name: Lockpick
actions.blurb: Two beats at a lock. Wants a clear corridor (a Lookout in the same beats).

lines.start: {crew} kneels at the lock and cracks their knuckles.
lines.crit: {crew} has it open before the lookout finishes saying 'all clear'.
lines.success: {crew} coaxes the lock open with a sound like a soft hiccup.
lines.partial: {crew} gets the lock open, but not quietly.
lines.fail: {crew} jams a pick in the keyhole and it will not come out.

actions.name: Hack
actions.blurb: Loop the camera feeds for a few beats.

lines.start: {crew} opens a laptop covered in stickers.
lines.crit: {crew} loops the footage and adds a small film score.
lines.success: {crew} loops the camera feeds. Every camera now watches the same pot plant.
lines.partial: {crew} loops the feeds, but one camera still sees a corner.
lines.fail: {crew} accidentally subscribes the cameras to a newsletter.

actions.name: Lookout
actions.blurb: Keep the corridor clear this beat. Lockpicking wants this.

lines.crit: {crew} gives a perfect all-clear and a thumbs up.
lines.partial: {crew} signals all-clear, then coughs. Mostly clear.
lines.fail: {crew} is watching a pigeon instead. Nobody is watching the corridor.

actions.name: Carry
actions.blurb: Pick up the loot and take it somewhere. Heavy things are loud.

lines.crit: {crew} lifts the prize like it is a bag of feathers.
lines.success: {crew} scoops up the prize and tucks it under one arm.
lines.partial: {crew} grabs the prize, and also a small decorative table, which falls over.
lines.fail: {crew} lifts with their back and says a word that echoes.

actions.name: Drive
actions.blurb: Be ready outside, then get everyone away.

lines.start: {crew} adjusts the mirrors for a long time.
lines.crit: {crew} takes a corner so smoothly the coffee does not ripple.
lines.success: {crew} pulls the van up exactly where it should be.
lines.fail: {crew} turns up with the wrong van. It is an ice cream van.

actions.name: Tidy up
actions.blurb: Wipe up evidence, spills and dust left by earlier beats.

lines.crit: {crew} leaves the place cleaner than they found it.
lines.partial: {crew} mops, mostly. A damp footprint remains.
lines.fail: {crew} mops the one dry bit of floor.

actions.name: Improvise
actions.blurb: No plan. Stays loose and tries to handle whatever lands this beat, using their best skill. A gamble.

lines.start: {crew} cracks their neck and says 'I'll think of something'.

actions.name: Standby
actions.blurb: Hold one kind of trouble in reserve (noise, crowd, cat...). Absorbs the first matching complication this beat, well. Costs a turn.

actions.name: Wait
actions.blurb: Do nothing on purpose. Free for skill-based help if trouble comes.
